name: polaris-browser-bridge
description: One-click setup for the Polaris Browser Bridge Chrome extension: automatic token pairing via Native Messaging, extension sync, and token management.

interface.shortDescription: Set up the Chrome extension and pair it automatically for the browser and social plugins.
interface.longDescription:
The single source and setup entry for the official Polaris Browser Bridge extension: syncs the extension to a stable directory in one click, registers the Native Messaging host to pair the token automatically, and provides status checks and token rotation. The browser-use and social plugins depend on this plugin.

Requires: Python ≥3.14, Chrome.
defaultPrompt: 查看浏览器扩展的连接状态。
